subject: Staged Private Deployment Pricing: ramp discounts, observability add-on, and pilot credits
messages:
From: Sasha Brown <sasha.brown@acmemed.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@acmemed.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deploy pricing breakdown request

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising. Our procurement and platform teams asked for a clear commercial breakdown for a private (VPC / on-prem) deployment so we can review with finance. High level ask:

- Line items for platform fee (annual vs monthly, what it covers)
- Per-GPU / per-node licensing or operator license structure
- Support tiers (response time / escalation / on-call) and per-tier pricing
- Any pilot / ramp discounts, migration credits, or observability add-on pricing (we plan to use Redwood Console heavily)
- Standard SOW / payment milestones and expected lead time for air-gapped delivery (if required)

I've attached a short usage projection and topology (6-8 GPUs across 2 sites during pilot). We're targeting a 6-month pilot (July–Dec) with a view to scale in Q1. Can you send a proposal/ballpark today so I can flag to Tom and procurement?

Thanks,
Sasha Brown
Director, Platform Engineering
AcmeMed
Attachment: AcmeMed_usage_projection.xlsx
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Brown <sasha.brown@acmemed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-11T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy pricing breakdown request

Hi Sasha — really appreciate the projection and the clear asks. Putting a concise commercial on paper below; attaching a draft SOW + pricing model for your team to review.

Summary proposal (pilot → scale):
- One-time setup & onboarding: $25k (covers airgap packaging, install runbook, 2 onsite/remote install days).
- Platform fee: billed monthly, standard $15k/month covering control plane access, model catalog, telemetry retention (30d), and security updates.
- Operator license: $1,100 / GPU-month (covers runtime licensing, KV cache management licensing).
- Ramp discounts: Pilot months (months 1–3) 30% off platform fee; months 4–12 15% off platform fee with a 12-month commit option.
- Observability add-on (Redwood Console extended): $500 / 1M tokens / month (includes token-level cost/latency dashboards, 12-month retention option priced separately).
- Migration retainer credit: If you sign a 12-month committed spend (> $250k ARR equivalent), we offer a $30k credit against the onboarding fee and 40 engineering hours of quantization/ops support.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 24h ticket SLA) included; Premium (24/7 on-call, 2h P1 response) +25% of platform fee. Onsite SRE blocks available as add-on.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (pricing model tab).

Next steps: If this looks directionally right I'll circulate SOW v2 with the ramp schedule spelled out and a simple PO template. Can you confirm who in procurement should receive the PO and whether the airgap packaging timeline (4–6 weeks) works?

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Private deploy pricing breakdown request — internal pricing note

Team — forwarding Sasha's note + my proposal for quick internal alignment before we send SOW v2. Key points / recommend counter-offer: 

1) Margin levers: we can protect margin if we trade a deeper pilot discount for a firm 12-month committed spend. Suggest: pilot months 1–3 at 35% off platform fee, with clause that conversion to 12-month commit within pilot locks in the remaining months at 15% off.
2) Observability: offer first month free and one free seat of extended console during pilot (helps them evaluate value). Beyond pilot charge per usage tier.
3) Migration/engineering credit: reserve 40 hours for quantization/kernel tuning (value to them, low variable cost to us).
4) Legal/SLA: have Legal accept standard SLA but include an explicit failover/capacity fallback to hosted variants for emergency (protects their uptime).

Ask David/IR: confirm we can commit to the 40h engineering credit (quantization) and whether premium support add-ons have room for upsell in month 4. If yes, I'll include the counter in SOW v2 and set a 7/23 PO deadline to lock early-adopter pricing.

-Kim
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Brown <sasha.brown@acmemed.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deploy pricing breakdown request

Our revised commercial (high level):
- Setup & onboarding: $25k (subject to $30k credit if 12-mo commit)
- Platform fee: $15k/mo standard; pilot months 1–3: 35% off; months 4–12: 15% off if conversion to 12-mo commit by end of pilot.
- Operator license: $1,100 / GPU-month; volume tiers available at >20 GPUs.
- Observability: first month free for pilot + one free extended console seat. After pilot: $450 / 1M tokens / month (10% pilot discount baked into conversion pricing).
- Engineering support: 40h quantization/ops credit if commit to 12 months.
- Support: Premium 24/7 add-on = +25% platform fee.

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_draft_v2.pdf, AcmeMed_usage_projection.xlsx

We'd like to hold the early-adopter concession (pilot discounts + credits) until 2026-07-23. If AcmeMed can issue a PO for the deposit by then we will guarantee the terms. Also, please send the security questionnaire — IR will work with your SecOps directly.

Let me know if you want us to set a short call with David (pricing) and Marissa (solutions engineering) to walk procurement through the model.

Best,
Kim
